C1181.title: AI Hallucinated Code Dependencies Spark Slopsquatting Supply Chain Attacks
C1181.summary: Security researchers uncovered that attackers are exploiting hallucinated package names generated by AI coding tools—such as data-validator-pro—to squat and inject malicious code into registries like PyPI and npm.
